title: DojoLiq Classic Chew 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid by Vaporesso
description: Vaporesso DojoLiq Classic Chew 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid delivers a smooth, comforting, and deeply nostalgic sweet shop profile. Experience the vibrant, sugary taste of mixed fruit candy on the inhale, which is then seamlessly complemented by a rich, chewy-tasting sweetness on the exhale, for a complex yet superbly balanced and distinctively confectionery-inspired finish. Formulated with a VG/PG ratio finely tuned specifically to this flavour, this premium nicotine salt e-liquid is crafted to provide precise clarity and a smooth, comfortable throat sensation. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths, it ensures rapid nicotine satisfaction. This tailored blend performs reliably with Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) refillable pod kits and classic starter devices, ensuring sharp and accurate flavour transmission. Brought to you by the hardware specialists at Vaporesso, the DojoLiq collection captures the vibrant, authentic flavours of their popular Dojo series in a versatile 10ml format. Offering more than 30 expertly crafted options, this range provides a highly cost-effective and dependable option for every palate. Beyond the sweet nostalgia of Classic Chew, vapers can explore other compelling profiles such as the sparkling Blackcurrant Lemonade or the dessert-inspired Rhubarb Custard.
